test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The trainee wanted to know the______of the course to get a better understanding of the job prospects.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'ins and outs.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the idioms/phrases given in the options:

 
 
 

 Idioms
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 ins and outs
 the detailed or complicated facts of something. (किसी चीज का विस्तृत या जटिल तथ्य)
 
 

 bird's eye view
 a broad view of a situation. (एक स्थिति का व्यापक दृष्टिकोण)
 
 

 crying need
 a very obvious need. (एक बहुत स्पष्ट आवश्यकता)
 
 

 tall talk
 boasting or exaggerated storytelling. (शेखी बघारना या अतिरंजित कहानी कहना)
 
 
 
 

 
• The context of the sentence is that to better understand the job prospects, the trainee wanted to understand **all the details** of the course.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate phrase to fill in the blank is "ins and outs."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

 
• Another example:

 
 
• *He quickly learned the **ins and outs** of the job.*
 
 

 

Complete Sentence:__ The trainee wanted to know the __ins and outs__ of the course to get a better understanding of the job prospects.
